description: Election Commission - Declare that P. G. Nihal Ashoka Silva was Selected as the member of the Chilaw Pradeshiya Sabha
categorisation: This gazette notice concerns the filling of a vacancy in a local government body (Chilaw Pradeshiya Sabha) due to a member's failure to attend meetings, which is a matter directly related to electoral processes and local authority membership under the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance. It involves the nomination and declaration of a new elected member to fill the vacancy, falling squarely within the scope of election-related administrative matters.
